0022600205.text: The Wizards (4-5, 2-3 on the road) are on a two-game losing streak and sit 8th in the East and 2nd in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, while the Pistons (6-2) are 1st in the Central and 3rd in the East after a loss in their most recent game. Washington is currently without Anthony Davis (ankle sprain), Deandre Ayton (leg), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain). The teams have not played each other yet this season, and the Wizards lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 117-95 loss in Washington on March 19, 2026.
